destination.name: Watarrka National Park
destination.tagline: Kings Canyon's sandstone walls, a rim walk and easy creek and spring walks in the Red Centre.
destination.description: Watarrka National Park is known for Kings Canyon, a sandstone canyon with walls up to 270 m high. The Rim Walk circles the top and drops to the Garden of Eden waterhole, while an easy walk follows Kings Creek along the canyon floor. In the south of the park a paved path leads to Kathleen Springs. Kings Canyon Resort, a short drive west of the canyon, has the area's accommodation, dining and tours.
whyVisit: Stroll Kings Creek below the canyon

goodToKnow.title: Parks pass required
goodToKnow.detail: Visitors need an NT Parks Visitor Pass: adult $10 for a day, $20 for three days. NT residents are exempt. Buy online at parkbookings.nt.gov.au.

goodToKnow.title: Rim Walk heat rule
goodToKnow.detail: On days forecast 36°C or higher the Rim Walk must start before 9 am, with no entry after. Carry plenty of water; there is little shade.

goodToKnow.title: Mereenie Loop permit
goodToKnow.detail: Driving in from Hermannsburg or Glen Helen on Larapinta Drive needs a Mereenie Loop Pass permit; get it before you set off.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: The cooler months, {months}, avoid the heat limits that apply on the Rim Walk from September to April.

notes: Destination point = Kings Canyon Resort (OSM node 77988056), the area's hub, ~6.7 km from the canyon car park; not a spot. All spots within ~20 km (limit 37.5 km). Kings Canyon pin is the canyon car park; Rim Walk pin is the loop midpoint, ~1.4 km apart. Resort is not a spot.
